text:
emma: Hey @people-ops — quick question: my spouse just lost coverage from their employer and wants to switch onto Redwood benefits. Is that a qualifying life event? What do I need to submit and how fast?

maria - People Ops: Yes, loss of other coverage is a QLE. You have 30 days from the loss date to enroll your spouse in our plan. Please attach the termination/COBRA notice or an employer statement as proof.

emma: Thanks — if I enroll within the 30 days, can the coverage be effective retroactively to the date their employer coverage ended?

maria - People Ops: Usually yes. We can set the effective date to the day after their prior coverage ended (or the end date on the termination letter). When you send the proof, tell us the exact loss date you want as the effective date.

raj: Quick follow-up — will payroll deduction be retro'd as well or just the coverage?

dylan - Payroll: We can retro-charge premiums back to the effective date but only if the enrollment paperwork + proof are received before the 30-day window closes. If payroll deadlines were missed for a past pay period, we’ll reconcile on the next cycle. I can run numbers once Maria confirms the effective date.

emma: Where do I submit the docs & form? Is there a form on the benefits portal?

maria - People Ops: Yep — go to https://benefits.redwood.com/claims -> "Life Event Enrollment". Fill the short QLE form and upload the proof document. Or email benefits@redwood.com with subject: "QLE - spouse loss of coverage - [employee name]" and attach the termination letter. Either works.

emma: Cool. I uploaded the letter and filled the portal form just now.

hr-bot: Submission received. Case ID: QLE-20260308-452. A People Ops rep will review within 2 business days.

maria - People Ops: Got it — I see your case ID. Can you confirm spouse's full name, DOB, and SSN (or last 4) in a secure reply? We need that to add them.

emma: Sent in secure form (portal upload). Thanks!

maria - People Ops: Perfect. I'll mark the effective date as 2026-03-01 per the termination letter, and we'll process enrollment. Dylan — FYI to calculate retro premium for Emma for March and April.

dylan - Payroll: Noted. I’ll prepare the payroll adjustment and share the amount here once calculated. Expect a follow-up by end of week. :+1:

emma: Amazing, thank you all! :heart:
